def prime_factorization(n):
    factors = Counter()
    d = 2
    temp = n
    while d * d <= temp:
        while temp % d == 0:
            factors[d] += 1
            temp //= d
        d += 1
    if temp > 1:
        factors[temp] += 1
    return factors

def get_prime_factors(n):
    return set(prime_factorization(n).keys())

def valuation(n, p):
